group.title: Introducing a walking tour
group.passage: M1: Welcome to the Old Port architecture walk. I'm Daniel, your guide. Our route normally begins at the customs house, but a television crew is filming there this morning. We'll start instead at the former grain exchange across the square and visit the customs house on our way back. The walk takes about ninety minutes and includes several uneven stone paths, so please watch your footing. Although most buildings on the route now contain offices, the old exchange has become a public art gallery. We'll spend fifteen minutes inside to see how its original trading hall was preserved. Photography is welcome there, but please turn off your flash. If you need a restroom before we leave, there is one beside the ticket counter.
group.passageZh: 歡迎參加老港建築步行導覽，我是Daniel。平常先到海關大樓，但今天早上有電視團隊拍攝，所以改從廣場對面的舊穀物交易所開始，回程再去海關。導覽約九十分鐘，有些石路不平，請留意腳步。沿路大部分建築現為辦公室，舊交易所則成為公共藝廊。我們會在裡面停留十五分鐘，看看原交易大廳如何保存。可以拍照，但請關閃光燈。出發前如需洗手間，售票櫃檯旁有一間。
